extracted.name: Asian Tuna Salad
extracted.description: This Asian-style tuna salad features vegetables and dried cranberries in a mayonnaise-based dressing with Asian-style chile paste, soy sauce, and honey.
ingredient_lines: 5 (5 ounce) cans chunk light tuna in water, drained and flaked
0.5 cup sweetened dried cranberries (such as Craisins®)
0.25 cup Asian chile paste (such as sambal oelek)
instruction_lines: Mix tuna, cranberries, carrot, green onions, cilantro, sesame seeds, ginger, ground chile pepper, and kosher salt together in a large bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise, chile paste, sesame oil, soy sauce, and honey together in a separate bowl; add to tuna mixture and stir to coat.
